parsed.why: Sodomy statutes unenforced per 2023 report; no trans-specific offence, targeting or violence documented. But no protections, documented service discrimination with no recourse, and fear of prosecution deters reporting. Thin data caps the score.

National 2025 birth-sex restroom laws are universal exposure for every outed visitor. Offset by no trans criminalisation, conversion-therapy ban, courts annulling hostile decrees and the first police torture conviction for anti-trans abuse.

Sodomy law with some enforcement; LGBTQ victims' status used against them, reporting deterred, concealment the norm, active push for harsher bills, no trans healthcare available. One labour protection is resident-facing and untested.

No criminalisation or border obstacle; anti-discrimination act covers gender identity in goods and services. Weighed against hostile public opinion, official ministerial hostility, failed criminalisation bills and a 2022 lethal bar shooting with no remedial progress.

2024 law criminalises trans identity itself: 10-15 years for relations, 1-3 for transition, deportation stated. Documented killings with impunity, militia targeting gender-nonconforming dress, UN calls the state a perpetrator.
